shared_elements: curved/linear engraved motifs on stone surface
justification: A is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure — a head with heavy brow and torso bearing low-relief motifs including a large disc and a girdle/belt band on the back — while B is a scattered field of small linear engravings dominated by repeated boats with crew-strokes, plus tiny stick-figures, cupmarks and a disc-like sign. The only overlap is the presence of human forms and a circular element on a rock surface, which is generic; the frontal three-dimensional single figure versus a dispersed two-dimensional narrative repertoire of boats shows no shared iconographic scheme.
